title: Dental Workspace Preview
releaseNotes: Adds an independent app update status panel.
checks: Protected M08 signer and external release-key directory met the required local permission checks.
Live signed sequence 14 metadata was verified before preparing sequence 15.
Existing company.sample.alpha and company.sample.beta catalogue entries were preserved.
The signed 1.3.0 package matched its catalogue digest, package identity, version, and zero-capability grant.
Temporary staging publisher enforced conditional writes, rejected anonymous and replay attempts, and was removed after publication.
Live sequence 15 catalogue and update policy signatures verified with the pinned staging trust.
The public R2 package bytes matched the signed digest and contained the new update-status panel.
A disposable DistributionService refresh with the prior public 1.2.0 package produced 1.3.0 available over installed 1.2.0; the Store view exposes enabled Download update alongside Open.
limits: The user's running Dental OS window was not manipulated.
The update-state check simulated an approved install-policy response; the user's manual Store refresh and Download update click-through remain pending.
No production resources or clinic business records were accessed or changed.
